The Red Cross has said at least 93,000 people may have been affected by Wednesday’s flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, which have killed nearly 600 people, left another 1,900 missing, and triggered a huge rescue operation that is being hampered by fears of new flooding. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC), the world’s largest humanitarian network, said it feared the death toll would continue to rise as some of the hardest-hit areas remained inaccessible after roads and bridges were destroyed by the torrents.

titulo.es: Irán y EE.UU. cumplen seis meses de guerra con crisis económica, bloqueo naval y represión interna
titulo.en: Iran and US mark six months of war amid economic crisis, naval blockade and internal crackdown

sintesis.es: Tras seis meses de conflicto iniciado con ataques conjuntos de EE.UU. e Israel contra Irán, persisten el estancamiento diplomático y el cierre del estrecho de Ormuz, generando una crisis energética global. Irán reconoce una caída cercana al 35% en su comercio exterior por sanciones y el bloqueo naval estadounidense, mientras pide diplomacia y fin de la ofensiva israelí en Gaza, Líbano y Siria. En paralelo, Teherán avanza en una ley que criminalizaría el contacto con medios extranjeros, endureciendo la represión interna.
sintesis.en: Six months into the conflict that began with joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran, diplomatic talks remain stalled and the Strait of Hormuz closure continues, fueling a global energy crisis. Iran acknowledges nearly a 35% drop in foreign trade due to sanctions and the US naval blockade, while calling for diplomacy and an end to Israeli offensives in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria. Meanwhile, Tehran advances a law that would criminalize contact with foreign media, tightening internal repression.

titulo.en: Los Angeles fire survivors face record wait for federal disaster aid under Trump

sintesis.es: deportó cerca de 2.300 mexicanos a Guatemala en 2026, y a decenas más a Honduras. El gobierno estadounidense está normalizando estas deportaciones a terceros países.
sintesis.en: Nearly 600 days after the devastating 2025 fires, thousands of Los Angeles residents are still waiting for more than $15bn in federal funds to rebuild their communities As thousands of residents in Spokane, Washington, begin to grapple with a long recovery after a destructive set of blazes that consumed hundreds of homes in the state’s second most populated city this month, victims of the Los Angeles firestorm broke a grim record – they have faced the longest delay in modern history for federal aid. Nearly 600 days since a historic firestorm roared into communities across Los Angeles, reducing more than 16,000 structures to ash and toxic debris, the Trump administration has failed to appropriate more than $15bn in long-term recovery funds that are crucial to rebuilding. The delay in supplying the badly needed funds is months longer than the last record set when victims of the Maui fires had to wait 500 days to receive the support, LAist noted this week.

titulo.es: Colapso glaciar en el Himalaya deja cientos de muertos y desaparecidos en Nepal y China
titulo.en: Himalayan glacier collapse leaves hundreds dead and missing in Nepal and China

sintesis.es: El colapso de un glaciar a unos 5.000 metros de altura en la cordillera del Himalaya provocó un enorme alud de lodo e inundaciones repentinas que afectaron a Nepal y al condado de Gyirong, en el Tíbet (China). El desastre ha dejado más de 600 muertos y hasta 1.400 desaparecidos, con comunidades aisladas e infraestructura destruida. China y Nepal reanudaron las labores de búsqueda y rescate tras una breve pausa, mientras la ONU despliega ayuda humanitaria y expertos advierten sobre el riesgo de un nuevo desbordamiento de un lago recién formado.
sintesis.en: The collapse of a glacier at about 5,000 meters in the Himalayan range triggered a massive mudslide and flash floods affecting Nepal and Gyirong county in Tibet, China. The disaster has left over 600 dead and up to 1,400 missing, with communities isolated and infrastructure destroyed. China and Nepal resumed search and rescue operations after a brief pause, while the UN deploys humanitarian aid and experts warn of the risk of a new outburst from a newly formed lake.

titulo.es: Brote de ébola en RD Congo alcanza escala sin precedentes y la ONU pide tregua humanitaria
titulo.en: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo reaches unprecedented scale as UN calls for humanitarian truce

sintesis.es: El brote de ébola Bundibugyo en la República Democrática del Congo ha superado los 5514 casos confirmados y 2642 muertes, propagándose a velocidad récord tras 100 días de epidemia. La OMS y la ONU advierten sobre el riesgo de propagación regional y piden una tregua humanitaria de seis meses para permitir el acceso a comunidades afectadas, señalando que la falta de acceso, no de recursos médicos, es el principal obstáculo. El secretario general de la ONU condenó la 'indiferencia' internacional ante la crisis, mientras organizaciones como la Cruz Roja enfrentan además un problema de desinformación y desconfianza comunitaria.
sintesis.en: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5514 confirmed cases and 2642 deaths, spreading at record speed after 100 days since being declared. WHO and UN officials warn of regional spread risk and are calling for a six-month humanitarian truce to allow access to affected communities, noting that lack of access—not medical knowledge or tools—is the main challenge. The UN Secretary-General condemned international 'indifference' toward the crisis, while organizations like the Red Cross also face a crisis of misinformation and community distrust.

actores: Cruz Roja y Media Luna Roja
